about.title: What is Cann'Agri Expo?
about.p1: Cann'Agri Expo is the first professional trade show dedicated to the CBD hemp industry in Western France. Held in Nantes, this event brings together producers, distributors, processors and industry experts for a day rich in exchanges and discoveries.
about.p2: Our goal is to create a privileged meeting space for all industry players: farmers, laboratories, specialized shops, and innovative project leaders in the hemp wellness sector.
about.p3: The {year} edition promises to be exceptional with around thirty exhibitors, conferences led by renowned experts, and the prestigious Platinum CBD Cup ceremony.
